note: Track steps-to-leaps, step 2: Do Re Mi over a drone, then two Do Re Mi tunes at 40 bpm, the first learned in the named stages down to a cappella, the second starting on Mi. Key and tempo are moves in place of the old Key selector; the {{?key}} line says Mi stays two steps above Do.

exercise.title: Do Re Mi: two steps up and home
exercise.why: Mi is one more step above Re, the same size as the step from Do to Re, so you reach it by taking the step you know twice.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Mi is the ringed note. Sing {{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}} from the low {{1}}, then step back down to {{1}}. Sing them on the note names.
If {{3}} comes out too low, tap it on the staff to hear it, then sing the three notes again.
_Don't reach for high notes: the staff shows more than this drill needs._

Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. The tune steps up from Do to Mi and back. Sing along on the note names.
Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
Once you can sing it without the tune leading you, press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing the tune a cappella.

This tune starts on Mi and steps down to Do. Tap its first note below to hear it. Then press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. Sing along on the note names.
Once the names come without thinking, sing it again on "la".
{{?key}}In another key the notes are new, and Mi is still two steps above Do.
